title: Frame & fork
description: Structural integrity, alignment, bearings, mounts, and visible damage or repairs.
criteria: Inspect frame and fork for cracks, dents, and repairs
Check frame and fork alignment
Check headset play, steerer, and bearings
Inspect seatpost fit, threads, mounts, and hardware

title: Wheels & tyres
description: Wheel condition, spoke tension, hub bearings, tyre casing, and tubeless setup.
criteria: Check rim condition and wheel trueness
Check spoke tension and nipple condition
Check hub rotation and bearing play
Inspect tyre casing, tread, and tubeless setup

title: Drivetrain
description: Wear, gear changes, chainrings, cassette, crank, and bottom bracket condition.
criteria: Measure chain wear
Inspect cassette and chainring teeth
Test gear changes across the full range
Check derailleur hanger, crank, and bottom bracket

title: Braking
description: Pad life, braking surfaces, lines or cables, lever feel, and braking force.
criteria: Measure brake pad thickness and remaining life
Inspect rotor or rim braking surfaces
Inspect hydraulic lines or cable condition
Test lever return, alignment, and braking force

title: Cockpit & fit
description: Contact points, fastener security, adjustability, and fit measurements.
criteria: Check bar, stem, and seatpost security
Inspect saddle rails and adjustment range
Check torque-critical fasteners
Record contact points and fit measurements

title: Ride test & records
description: Loaded road test, handling, unusual noises, frame identity, and included items.
criteria: Complete a road test under load
Test shifting, braking, handling, and unusual noise
Record frame or serial number
Confirm included components and ownership details
